subject: Access controls: SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist and service accounts — Cielo Health onboarding
messages:
From: Adam Fowler <adam.fowler@cielohealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@cielohealth.com, lisa.chen@cielohealth.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff - access controls for Redwood onboarding

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to start the onboarding for Redwood but have a handful of dependencies on our side around identity and networking. Attached is our security questionnaire (partial) to help scope the work. High-level items we need to validate: 

- SSO: our IdP is Azure AD (SAML 2.0). We prefer SP-initiated SAML but can do IdP-initiated if needed. Can you confirm metadata endpoints and whether you support multiple ACS URLs?
- SCIM: we want group-based provisioning for application roles (Engineering/Product). Are groups syncable and can you support mapped attributes for department and role?
- IP allowlist: we need an explicit list of egress IPs for API calls from our VPC so we can update firewall rules.
- Service accounts: we need a small set of machine/service accounts (CI pipelines and integrations) and a template for expected keys/rotation cadence.

Can we schedule a short technical sync this week (30m) to align on these items and produce a mutual action plan? Proposed times below.

Attachments: Cielo_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (excerpt)

Thanks,
Adam Fowler
Head of IT Operations
Cielo Health
adam.fowler@cielohealth.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Adam Fowler <adam.fowler@cielohealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff - access controls for Redwood onboarding

Hi Adam — great to hear from you and thanks for the questionnaire.

We can run a focused 30-minute technical kickoff to cover SSO metadata, SCIM mapping, IP allowlist ranges, and service-account needs. Proposed slots:
- Thu 2026-11-05 09:30-10:00 PT
- Thu 2026-11-05 13:00-13:30 PT
- Fri 2026-11-06 11:00-11:30 PT

Quick answers to your bullets so you have a sense before the call:
- SSO: we support SP-initiated SAML by default and can configure multiple ACS URLs per customer environment. We’ll provide the SP metadata XML and an ACS list.
- SCIM: group sync is supported; we can map Azure AD group -> Redwood role and sync department, title, and manager attributes. Admin-only provisioning is available if you prefer manual control.
- IP allowlist: we will provide an egress CIDR block and a short-lived public endpoint for initial testing; for production we'll coordinate with Redwood Dedicated/Private team to pin ranges.
- Service accounts: we'll send a CSV template (service-accounts-template.csv) that lists required fields and rotation guidance.

I've attached our onboarding checklist to help the call stay focused. On the call we'll produce a mutual action plan and owners. If Thu 9:30 PT works, I'll lock it and send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Cielo Health tech notes ahead of sync

Internal notes (for CS + Eng pre-read) — do not forward externally: 

- SAML/IdP specifics: Azure AD usually expects an SP metadata URL and can do multiple ACS endpoints. Confirm EntityID format; some customers expect an HTTPS entity id that matches SP metadata.
- SCIM: current Redwood SCIM supports users, groups, and custom attributes. Group-to-role sync needs mapping on our side; marissa to own mapping table.
- IP allowlist: for initial launch we can provide these ranges: 52.34.120.0/24, 34.216.10.0/24 (example). For Dedicated/Private customers we support static egress; for hosted customers we provide a published range that is updated quarterly.
- Service accounts: we'll create service accounts scoped to project-level roles. Recommend rotation every 90 days; support for short-lived tokens via Vault is in our backlog (Q1).

Action items for the kickoff:
1) Marissa: bring SCIM attribute mapping template and sample CSV.
2) Monica: prepare IP range doc and note Dedicated vs Hosted differences.
3) Hannah: own external comms and finalize meeting agenda.
4) Engineering (Jonas): confirm ACS/multi-ACS support on staging and capture SP metadata file for Adam.

Attachments: (internal) service-accounts-template.csv

— Jonas

From: Adam Fowler <adam.fowler@cielohealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@cielohealth.com>, security@cielohealth.com
Date: 2026-11-06T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff - access controls for Redwood onboarding

Thanks — Thu 11/5 09:30 PT worked for us (we joined on the call). Couple of clarifications from our side after talking to the IdP admin: 

- ACS URLs: we have both an app-based ACS and a generic redirect URL for our SSO gateway. We'd prefer SP metadata that supports both (SP entity + ACS list).
- Group provisioning: we need group membership preserved and a mapped attribute "cielo_role" so downstream systems can consume role info. Is that a custom attribute mapping or a standard SCIM extension?
- IP allowlist: the firewall team needs a referenceable ticket that includes the expected egress CIDRs and timeline; can you provide the CIDRs in a single file and indicate which ones are initial-test vs production?

Link to our onboarding notes: https://cielohealth.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/IT/pages/123456/SSO+and+SCIM

We can provide a short CSV with sample service account names; attaching an example.

Best,
Adam
